set(KERNEL_BUILD_TARGET "build-tta-sim-kernels-5gnr-ldpc")
set(KERNEL_SIM_TARGET "simulate-tta-kernels-5gnr-ldpc")
set(KERNEL_NAME "sim_5gnr_ldpc")
set(TTA_SIM_PROGRAM "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/${KERNEL_NAME}")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# TTA simulation architecture/program files
#
# The ADF files are source/input files.
#
# The encode/decode TPEFs are generated by the corresponding child targets:
#
#   build-tta-sim-kernels-5gnr-ldpc-encode
#   build-tta-sim-kernels-5gnr-ldpc-decode
#
# through:
#
#   cores/encode/CMakeLists.txt
#   cores/decode/CMakeLists.txt
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
set(SIM_ENCODE_ADF_FILE "${OPENASIP_ROOT}/arch/sim_5gnr_ldpc_encode.adf")
set(SIM_DECODE_ADF_FILE "${OPENASIP_ROOT}/arch/sim_5gnr_ldpc_decode.adf")
set(SIM_ENCODE_TPEF_FILE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/cores/encode/sim_5gnr_ldpc_encode.tpef")
set(SIM_DECODE_TPEF_FILE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/cores/decode/sim_5gnr_ldpc_decode.tpef")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Common LDPC generated files
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
get_property(LDPC_COMMON_GENERATED_DIR GLOBAL PROPERTY LDPC_COMMON_GENERATED_DIR)
get_property(LDPC_COMMON_N0_TABLE GLOBAL PROPERTY LDPC_COMMON_N0_TABLE)
get_property(LDPC_COMMON_NORMAL_SAMPLES GLOBAL PROPERTY LDPC_COMMON_NORMAL_SAMPLES)

if(NOT LDPC_COMMON_GENERATED_DIR)
    message(FATAL_ERROR
        "Common 5G NR LDPC CMake infrastructure was not initialized."
    )
endif()

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Source files
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
file(
    GLOB_RECURSE LDPC_TTA_SIM_SOURCES
    CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/*.cpp"
)
file(
    GLOB_RECURSE LDPC_TTA_SIM_HEADERS
    CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include/*.h"
)
file(
    GLOB_RECURSE LDPC_TTA_SIM_COMMON_SOURCES
    CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/common/src/*.cpp"
)
file(
    GLOB_RECURSE LDPC_TTA_SIM_COMMON_HEADERS
    CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/common/include/*.h"
)
file(
    GLOB_RECURSE LDPC_COMMON_SOURCES
    CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
    "${OPENASIP_ROOT}/targets/common/kernels/5gnr/ldpc/src/*.cpp"
)
file(
    GLOB_RECURSE LDPC_COMMON_HEADERS
    CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
    "${OPENASIP_ROOT}/targets/common/kernels/5gnr/ldpc/include/*.h"
)
file(
    GLOB_RECURSE LDPC_OSED_SOURCES
    CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
    "${OPENASIP_ROOT}/arch/custom/osal/kernels/5gnr/ldpc/*"
)

list(FILTER LDPC_TTA_SIM_SOURCES EXCLUDE REGEX "/temp/")
list(FILTER LDPC_COMMON_SOURCES EXCLUDE REGEX "/gen-n0/")
list(FILTER LDPC_COMMON_SOURCES EXCLUDE REGEX "/gen-random/")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Encode/decode TPEF generation
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
add_subdirectory(cores/encode)
add_subdirectory(cores/decode)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# SystemC host executable
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
add_executable(${KERNEL_BUILD_TARGET}
    ${LDPC_TTA_SIM_SOURCES}
    ${LDPC_TTA_SIM_COMMON_SOURCES}
    ${LDPC_COMMON_SOURCES})

set_target_properties(${KERNEL_BUILD_TARGET}
    PROPERTIES
        OUTPUT_NAME "${KERNEL_NAME}")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Include paths
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
target_include_directories(${KERNEL_BUILD_TARGET} PRIVATE
    "${LDPC_COMMON_GENERATED_DIR}"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/common/include"
    "${OPENASIP_ROOT}/targets/common/kernels/5gnr/ldpc/include"
    "${OPENASIP_ROOT}/targets/tta/kernels/common/lib/cpp"
    "${OPENASIP_ROOT}/targets/common/kernels/lib/cpp")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# OpenASIP configuration
#
# openasip-config --includes:
#
#   -I/home/victor/local/include
#   -I/home/victor/local/include/tce
#   -pthread
#   -I/usr/include
#
# openasip-config --libs:
#
#   -L/home/victor/local/lib
#   -lopenasip
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
find_program(OPENASIP_CONFIG_EXECUTABLE
    openasip-config
    REQUIRED)

execute_process(
    COMMAND "${OPENASIP_CONFIG_EXECUTABLE}" --includes
    OUTPUT_VARIABLE OPENASIP_CONFIG_INCLUDES
    OUTPUT_STRIP_TRAILING_WHITESPACE
    RESULT_VARIABLE OPENASIP_CONFIG_INCLUDES_RESULT)

if(NOT OPENASIP_CONFIG_INCLUDES_RESULT EQUAL 0)
    message(FATAL_ERROR
        "Failed to execute: ${OPENASIP_CONFIG_EXECUTABLE} --includes")
endif()

execute_process(
    COMMAND "${OPENASIP_CONFIG_EXECUTABLE}" --libs
    OUTPUT_VARIABLE OPENASIP_CONFIG_LIBS
    OUTPUT_STRIP_TRAILING_WHITESPACE
    RESULT_VARIABLE OPENASIP_CONFIG_LIBS_RESULT)

if(NOT OPENASIP_CONFIG_LIBS_RESULT EQUAL 0)
    message(FATAL_ERROR
        "Failed to execute: ${OPENASIP_CONFIG_EXECUTABLE} --libs")
endif()

separate_arguments(
    OPENASIP_CONFIG_INCLUDES
    UNIX_COMMAND
    "${OPENASIP_CONFIG_INCLUDES}")

separate_arguments(
    OPENASIP_CONFIG_LIBS
    UNIX_COMMAND
    "${OPENASIP_CONFIG_LIBS}")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Compile options
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
target_compile_options(${KERNEL_BUILD_TARGET} PRIVATE
    ${OPENASIP_CONFIG_INCLUDES}
    -DMULTICORE_TTA # see defines.h
    $<$<CONFIG:Release>:-O3>

    $<$<CONFIG:Debug>:-g3>
    $<$<CONFIG:Debug>:-fno-omit-frame-pointer>
    $<$<CONFIG:Debug>:-fsanitize=address,undefined>

    $<$<CONFIG:RelWithDebInfo>:-g3>
    $<$<CONFIG:RelWithDebInfo>:-fno-omit-frame-pointer>)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Link options
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
target_link_options(${KERNEL_BUILD_TARGET} PRIVATE
    $<$<CONFIG:Debug>:-fsanitize=address,undefined>)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Libraries
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
target_link_libraries(${KERNEL_BUILD_TARGET}
    PRIVATE
        ldpc-common
        ${OPENASIP_CONFIG_LIBS}
        systemc)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# TTA simulation
#
# The SystemC executable receives the four simulation files as argv:
#
#   argv[1] = encoder ADF
#   argv[2] = encoder TPEF
#   argv[3] = decoder ADF
#   argv[4] = decoder TPEF
#
# No TPEF generation is performed by this simulation target itself.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
add_custom_target(${KERNEL_SIM_TARGET}
    COMMAND "$<TARGET_FILE:${KERNEL_BUILD_TARGET}>"
            "${SIM_ENCODE_ADF_FILE}"
            "${SIM_ENCODE_TPEF_FILE}"
            "${SIM_DECODE_ADF_FILE}"
            "${SIM_DECODE_TPEF_FILE}"
    WORKING_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}"
    USES_TERMINAL)
